images.scene: Robinson sits inside his shelter with his tame parrot Poll perched on his hand, the bird talking to him while a dog and household goat kids rest nearby.
images.alt: A bearded castaway with a parrot on his hand and animals around him inside his shelter.

images.scene: Robinson lies flat on his belly at the top of a hill, peering through a perspective glass down at nine naked savages sitting round a small fire on the distant shore, two canoes hauled up on the sand.
images.alt: A man lies on a hilltop looking through a spyglass at figures around a fire on a far beach.

images.scene: At night in a storm with lightning overhead, Robinson piles dry wood and sets a large blazing bonfire on the hilltop as a signal toward the dark sea.
images.alt: A man tends a large blazing bonfire on a hill at night during a lightning storm by the sea.

images.scene: Robinson stands over the washed-up corpse of a drowned boy lying on the sand at the edge of the island, the boy in a seaman's waistcoat and blue linen shirt, waves behind.
images.alt: A man stands over a drowned boy's body washed up on the beach.

images.scene: A dismal Spanish ship lies jammed fast between two rocks at sea, its stern beaten to pieces and its mainmast and foremast broken short off, seen from Robinson's small canoe approaching.
images.alt: A broken wrecked ship stuck between rocks at sea, viewed from a small boat.

images.scene: A starving dog leaps from the deck of the wrecked ship into the sea toward Robinson, who reaches out from his small boat to pull the animal aboard.
images.alt: A dog jumps off a shipwreck into the water toward a man reaching out from a small boat.
